Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class NewTrainingParticipationDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.NewTrainingParticipationDTO
public class NewTrainingParticipationDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for recording a user's participation in a training.

Captures the basic linkage between a participant, their manager, and a specific training instance — along with the timestamp of when participation occurred. Commonly used when submitting training completion records or tracking user progress. JAXB annotations support XML serialization for endpoints that exchange XML payloads.

Attributes: - participantId: ID of the user who attended the training - managerId: ID of the user's manager responsible for assigning or approving training - trainingId: ID of the training session completed - participatedAt: Timestamp indicating when the participation took place
